title: AWS Marketplace Registration Completion Error
description: Error body for POST /api/v1/billing/marketplace/complete. Every error branch returns exactly `{"error": <fixed literal>}` -- no `success`/`message` envelope fields. 404 covers two distinct causes (integration disabled, or the registration handle itself was never found): 400 = registration_id missing from the JSON body; 403 = the asserted tenant_id disagreed with the authenticated session's own tenant; 404 = integration disabled OR RegistrationNotFoundError; 409 = RegistrationAlreadyClaimedError, or DoubleBillingError (tenant already has an entitling Paddle subscription), or AlreadyLinkedError (purchase already linked to a different tenant); 410 = RegistrationExpiredError. See src/routes/marketplace_routes.py:complete.

enum: tenant_id does not match the authenticated session's tenant; a purchase can only be claimed into a tenant you belong to
registration expired; start again from AWS Marketplace
this tenant already has an entitling Paddle subscription; cancel it before linking an AWS Marketplace purchase
this AWS Marketplace purchase is already linked to another tenant
